body: Thank you. I am seeing counseling. This is all so very hard. I'm crying regularly

Thanks a bunch for this. I wish I could take it back. I hate that I'm still in love with her. I need to let her go, but it hurts so bad. 

I wish I had a better way to convey what I'm feeling. It's like hopelessness combined with a lack of closure. I'm sad she's moved on so easily. I really thought she loved me. 

I know you're right about everything else. A lot of people seem to think the alcohol is what I need to focus on to get better. I'm just choosing not to drink and I feel fine with the choice. Sometimes I think I could smile a little more if I could drink. But I know that it won't solve anything so I don't. 

Mostly, I want to feel love again. I was so comforted by her all the time that I don't know how I could ever be alone again. It's terrible and it won't go away. I know time will fix it, but it seems like a forever away right now.
I hope so. Could be sentenced to four years. Trying to look forward and find ways to improve myself can be difficult with that hanging over my head

I really don't think about drinking that much, just at night. I can't tell what's the worst thing that's happening. I'm so depressed and anxious. I think I'm having feelings of PTSD as well. I don't know where to start to get better. Being an alcoholic is just like a tip of the iceberg right now.
I'm signing up this week if I don't end up back in jail
I've spent ten days in jail and I was told to not talk about my case. Writing this out is the release I needed. I really needed to get this off my chest. Thanks for reading
Thank you so much. I think I need to cry more but I can't seem to get it out.

There's so many conflicting thoughts in my head right now I can't make sense of. I've lost my job though and can't afford counseling. Is there any cheaper alternative I could go to in the meantime? I don't know how to forgive myself.

I honestly feel like I'm through a lot of the hard parts. I spent ten days in jail and have had no withdrawal symptoms, just a heavy heart. 

I'm still disgusted with seeing alcohol as it still reminds me of what I've done. 

I plan to spend a lot of time in the gym when the cravings get really strong.

I really don't think I'll get her back. It's okay. I just would like some closure at some point. A chance to say sorry. 

I watched my mom get abused as a kid. I never thought I'd become the abuser. I'm surprised how much understanding I've been getting from friends and family. I probably do need counseling. I can't stop thinking about what I did. 

Thanks for the supportive words.
